layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.

The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Subject: a big cheerful storybook castle town that fills the whole image from the left edge to the right edge, seen from above at a three-quarter angle: a wide oval ring of crenellated curtain walls of pale cream limestone #e6d8b4 with #b3a07a shadows; the front wall runs across the bottom of the image facing the viewer, and in the exact middle of the front wall a big gatehouse with two round towers and a dark arched gate; four round towers on the ring with pointed conical roofs of tabard blue #2f6fd0 with #1f4a8f shadows; inside the walls a tall square keep at the back with a blue conical roof, a long timber-framed hall with a warm red-brown roof #a8492f and white plaster walls, and a small chapel. The yard is empty and transparent: nothing is drawn under the town. Buildings only.
